title: Doctor Strange vs Doctor Fate
script: This is Doctor Strange. This is Doctor Fate. So what's the difference? Most fans think Doctor Fate copied Doctor Strange. It's actually the opposite. Doctor Strange draws arcane energy through study and spells as Sorcerer Supreme. But Doctor Fate is a mortal host possessed by Nabu, a Lord of Order through the Helmet of Fate. Strange casts spells with human agency, while Fate acts as a divine puppet of Order. Follow for more.
